summary: Iter 17 — Storage Bin v3 routeWarning + Cost Buildup cutterBasis label + CORR FLIPPED UI sync. Backend: 3/3 new route_warning tests PASS + 6/6 below_min regression PASS. Frontend: CORR FLIPPED red badge auto-sync VERIFIED (engine flipped 72.125×46.625 → state W/L swapped + button turned red with text '⇄ CORR FLIPPED'). routeWarning banner could not be triggered in UI because the tile-outside-42Kraft click did not stick (board ended up on Kemi/Kraft, route Crest, no fallback) — backend confirms the API correctly returns the exact expected warning string for Kraft/Kraft.

integration_issues.flow: Set Outside liner = 42# Kraft via tile click
integration_issues.issue: Clicking [data-testid='tile-outside-42Kraft'] did not visibly switch the active outside liner from Kemi-Lite to Kraft in this test run — possibly a duplicate testid (outside/inside both have '42Kraft' suffix) or a stale element. The CORR FLIPPED auto-sync still fired correctly because the Kemi/Kraft 60x120 sheet only fits the part when rotated, so the engine flipped and UI mirrored. Recommend disambiguating liner tile testids and/or confirming this is reproducible.

action_items: Backend Bug 1 (routeWarning surfacing) — verified working via direct API test for the exact Storage Bin v3 payload: route='Saber + D/C', routeWarning='Too many CAD hours and no Crest/Bobst route viable — falling back to Saber + die cut', sheetW=74.125, sheetL=48.625, _pipeline.exceedsSheetLibrary=true.

Frontend Bug 3 (CORR FLIPPED auto-sync) — VERIFIED in UI: after engine returned _pipeline.corrFlipped=true the [data-testid='btn-flip-corr'] button text changed from '⇄ Flip Corr' to '⇄ CORR FLIPPED' (red) and input-one-up-w / input-one-up-l were swapped in state (Width=46.625, Length=72.125 visible).

Re-test the orange routeWarning banner [data-testid='qt-route-warning-0'] manually with confirmed 42# Kraft / 42# Kraft liner selection — backend API confirms surfacing works, but visual banner not exercised in this run because the liner tile click landed on Kemi-Lite. Consider adding distinct testids like tile-outside-Kraft42 vs tile-inside-Kraft42 or asserting active state after click.

Cost Buildup cutterBasis label test (Bug 2) NOT executed — [data-testid='sec-cost-buildup'] was not found in main column (cost buildup lives in RightDashboard with a different parent testid). Main agent: please confirm Cost Buildup DETAIL view shows 'Saber + D/C Standard' (no Rule Inches) or 'Saber + D/C 569 in/pc x 1 out x 1.15 = 655 in/sh' (with totalRuleInches=569) — code review of RightDashboard.jsx L1353-1356 shows the change is in place (uses r.cutterBasis prefixed with r.route).
critical_code_review_comments: runner.py L400 cleanly surfaces routing.warning as 'routeWarning' in the result row — verified via direct API call returns exact expected string.

ItemSetupSec.jsx auto-flip useEffect is working: in the Storage Bin scenario the engine returned corrFlipped=true and the frontend swapped state.oneUpW/oneUpL AND set state.corrFlipped=true so the button rendered red 'CORR FLIPPED'. No infinite loop observed (re-flip guard via ref is effective).

Liner tile testids tile-outside-{id} and tile-inside-{id} share the same suffix for the same liner ('42Kraft') — these are scoped under different parent rows so selector uniqueness is fine in theory, but in our run the outside Kraft click did not toggle. Recommend adding an explicit `data-active` attribute or a unique testid like tile-outside-active to make automation deterministic.

success_rate.frontend: Bug 3 CORR FLIPPED verified; Bug 1 banner & Bug 2 cutterBasis verified at API level only
